source_and_permissions.origin: User-provided reference; local source SHA-256 verified at task start.
source_and_permissions.allowed_use: Private local visual comparison and metadata-only design registration.
source_and_permissions.rights_note: The reference includes personal fish-catch photography. No image bytes, crops, embeddings or screenshot-derived photo assets may enter Git, Pages or CI artifacts.

visual_direction.rendering_note: Reference samples anchor hue only. The camera ring and Hero edge are layered translucent materials with local highlights and refraction; do not render them as flat fills or one simple gradient.
visual_direction.brand: Use the existing registered wordmark artwork and proportions in deep lake blue; no text recreation, thick stroke or visible glow.
visual_direction.statistics: Keep three equal columns and real values. Use thin, low-emphasis aqua dividers; no separate statistic cards.
visual_direction.hero: Pearl-white fine edge, restrained local aqua refraction on the sides/top, and only a trace of warm reflection at the bottom. Neighbor edges are quieter than the active Hero.
visual_direction.capture_guide: Keep the existing centered copy with two symmetric short aqua lines; no glow dots or independent click target.
visual_direction.camera: Pearl center, fine champagne-gold camera glyph, transparent blue/green crystal ring with real layered thickness, local highlights and soft ambient spill. Keep artwork centered within the V2 visual bound and measure touch bounds separately.
visual_direction.photo_and_data: Use the current FishRecord and runtime profile media. Never hardcode the screenshot's person, avatar, fish photo, species, measurements, location or time.
visual_direction.layout: Preserve the existing Top/Middle/Footer composition. Use the NH01 Responsive Layout V2 contract as the only numerical authority.

responsive_authority.numeric_policy: No new size, spacing, type, safe-area or overflow values are introduced by this visual authority.

exclusions: No photo bytes in repository, Pages output or CI artifacts.
No new whole-page bitmap, parallel Demo, Figma file or screenshot overlay.
No change to FishRecord data semantics or pager identity.
No modification of the frozen NH01 Responsive Layout V2 values.
